name: Amcomri Group plc
summary: Amcomri Group plc is a UK-based enterprise primarily engaged in engineering and industrial manufacturing, structured into two key divisions: Embedded Engineering and B2B Manufacturing. The Embedded Engineering division delivers specialized technical and engineering solutions across industrial, infrastructure, and transportation sectors. Its services encompass mechanical and electrical engineering, including the maintenance, refurbishment, and safety re-certification of critical valves essential for process and power industries. This division also handles the restoration, modernization, and enhancement of heavy-duty rotating shafts and components used in marine, power, petrochemical, and base metal processing applications. Furthermore, it distributes and services advanced electronic production equipment and provides comprehensive overhaul and repair for railway control electronics, traction power systems, motors, and resistive braking units, as well as managing the full lifecycle of voltage systems from procurement to final testing. The B2B Manufacturing division focuses on producing custom-engineered gaskets, seals, and specialized PTFE components for the food and specialty chemical industries. It offers precision CNC milling and turning services, supplies adhesive tape converting solutions, and manufactures a variety of interface products such as switches, keypads, graphic overlays, and different types of labels. This segment also provides general manufacturing, machining, and assembly services. Beyond these core operations, Amcomri produces various paper and paperboard articles and conducts technical testing and analysis. Established in 2016, the company's headquarters are situated in London, UK.
